claims.statement: Local Compose runs a bind-mounted Node development service and a PostgreSQL service whose database data is held in the named pg_data volume.

The production CMS is read-only and persists public media through a host mount plus a named Next cache volume, while production PostgreSQL uses the separate host-mounted db_data directory and PGDATA subdirectory.
The production Dockerfile is runtime-only: it installs production dependencies and copies a prebuilt .next directory, public assets, source, scripts, and required configuration files.
The release script pulls images, runs the cms-migrate profile, and then starts the CMS service.
The production database initialization script creates a limited cms login role when absent and grants it database, schema, table, sequence, and default privileges.
Payload migration registration is ordered in src/migrations/index.ts and supplies both up and down functions for each listed migration.
